messages:
toni: Uploaded new experimental visuals + upstream CSVs. Need quick decisions: single hero metric for PLG, enterprise callout, and what to gate behind the whitepaper.

zach: For PLG, use median latency on 128-token chat as the hero (users perceive speed). For enterprise, surface p95 and an SLA teaser. Avoid hard multipliers in hero copy.

mira: Visual idea: hero card with metric + tiny sparkline, then an expandable methodology panel. For the deeper dive, a latency CDF + a cost vs latency scatter that flags recommended configs.

oscar: Suggest an additional waterfall chart that breaks down per-token cost (base infer + KV cache hits + batching amortization) so teams can see where savings come from.

felix: Lead capture: form fields = email, company, team size bracket, expected_monthly_tokens bracket, deployment_interest (hosted/dedicated/private). If deployment_interest includes private OR team_size >= 150 OR expected_monthly_tokens >= 15M -> mark Enterprise and notify AE.

toni: Add a small checkbox for "Need SLA" and a free-text field for brief use-case. Also log UTM params and set events bench_view, bench_whitepaper_request, bench_try_api.

zach: Copy variants: PLG headline short option = "Fast inference, lower unit cost." Long option = "Low-latency inference that scales affordably." Enterprise headline = "Predictable latency and economics for production LLMs."

mira: Accessibility: ensure markers beyond color (patterns/labels) and provide alt text. Palette should pass for common colorblind types.

oscar: For the blog, include a short reproducibility appendix: model versions, GPU types, quantization settings, batch sizes, and the seed. Link raw CSVs and a tiny script to replay measurements.

felix: Webinar plan: 45 minute technical demo + 15 minute AMA. Title idea: "Engineering LLM serving: practical knobs to hit latency and cost targets." Offer the whitepaper as gated follow-up.

toni: Quick routing spec: HubSpot form -> create contact + company -> evaluate rules -> if Enterprise then AE Slack webhook and create high-priority lead; otherwise enroll in product drip sequence.

zach: For the hero delta, prefer relative phrasing "up to X% lower median latency" and always footnote the baseline used. Keep legal happy.

mira: Small interactive suggestion: let engineers toggle sequence length and a checkbox for KV cache on/off so they can see where gains appear. Frontend will need a tiny JSON endpoint with the CSVs and CORS.

oscar: I'll prepare the waterfall CSV and annotated scatter points with labels for quantization and batching settings.

felix: I'll build the HubSpot skeleton and add UTM capture + event firing for bench_try_click and whitepaper_download. Also add a quick lead scoring tag for "private_deploy_interest".

toni: Timelines: lock hero copy & visual direction by Tue, HubSpot flow ready by Thu, blog live middle of next week, webinar two weeks after publish.

pipeline-bot: [system] artifact added: /shared/marketing/bench/experiments/bench-experiment-2026-03-23.zip by toni at 2026-03-23T10:02:11Z

zach: One last thing: show p50 and p95 in the small stats table under the hero so both audiences see the right number.

mira: Agreed. I'll mock the hero + three-panel blog comps and include alt text and methodology card.

oscar: Sounds good. Will drop the waterfall and annotated scatter CSVs in the same folder.

toni: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate decisions into the draft doc and ping this thread for final signoff before publishing.
